description_sq: Ofrojme apartament per shitje tek Liqeni i Thate. Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje pallat te ri ne faze suvatimi. Eshte i strukturuar ne ambient ndenje se bashku me gatimin, 1 dhome gjumi, 1 tualet dhe ballkon. Per me shume informacion mund te na kontaktoni.
description_en: We offer an apartment for sale at Lake Thate. The apartment is located in a new building in the plastering phase. It is structured in a living room together with the kitchen, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and a balcony. For more information you can contact us.
